justification: Replaces WaitlistButton with CheckoutButton across 7 tool components + 6 test files. No DB changes, no new API routes — uses existing Stripe checkout routes. Payment flow is critical path but logic is simple (POST + redirect). Not Critical because no new backend logic, no data model changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: Stripe price IDs in Vercel env vars. Existing checkout API routes at /api/stripe/checkout/{product}. No DB interaction.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If STRIPE_*_PRICE_ID env var is not set, checkout route returns 500 'Payment not configured'. CheckoutButton shows the error message to user.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Frontend-only change. No existing data affected.

functions.name: CheckoutButton
functions.output: Renders button, POSTs to checkoutPath, redirects to Stripe checkout_url
functions.if_none: If checkout_url is null/undefined in response, shows 'No checkout URL returned' error

values.read_at: Each tool component at CheckoutButton prop
values.guard_at: Fallback to empty string: { report_id: result.report_id ?? '' }
values.if_missing: Stripe checkout route returns 400, CheckoutButton shows error
User sees 'No checkout URL returned' error

break_it.scenario: report_id is undefined when user clicks Buy
break_it.what_happens: POST body has report_id='', route returns 400, user sees error
break_it.repro: Run flood check with API returning no report_id → click Buy

break_it.what_happens: Route returns 500 'Payment not configured', user sees error
break_it.how: Each route.ts checks priceId. All IDs confirmed set except Verify/Intelligence Brief (no checkout enabled).

break_it.scenario: User clicks Buy while Stripe rate-limits (429) due to rapid re-clicks
break_it.what_happens: Stripe checkout route returns 500, user sees 'Failed to create checkout session'
break_it.how: CheckoutButton.tsx:90 — button disabled during loading state prevents rapid clicks. Error state re-enables button for retry.
break_it.repro: Click Buy rapidly 10+ times in <1s → observe only 1 request fires, button stays disabled

post_merge.secrets: No — uses existing STRIPE_*_PRICE_ID env vars
post_merge.manual_verify: Visit each tool page in Vercel preview, run analysis, click Buy, verify Stripe checkout loads
